_note: Gland and piston of the two verified cylinder designs of project 13 (hydraulic-cylinder-design-verification): HD-160 rev B and LD-80 rev C. Dimensions copied from that project's calculation reports (reports/HD-160.md and reports/LD-80.md, 'Rows derived from the verified design'), which are also the rows its CNC part-family generator (project 07) turned into lathe programs. Groove sizes there are illustrative by size band, not seal-catalogue values. Stock bore, clamp allowance and fits are assumptions of this project and are marked so.

sources.dimensions: project 13 reports/LD-80.md and reports/HD-160.md, CNC rows (gland: od, rod_d + id_clear, grooves with bottom_d, width, z; piston: bore_d - od_clear, inner_d, seal and guide grooves, guide_inset)
sources.piston groove positions: derived from project 13's rows: guide grooves at guide_inset from each face, seal groove centred
sources.fits: gland OD f7 in the H8 honed bore (H8/f7 clearance fit) and piston bore H7 on the rod spigot: assumed design practice. Rod-seal groove diameter H9 (rod f8/h9) CHECKED: Trelleborg 'Hydraulic Seals - Linear, Rod Seals' (Edition January 2011), Turcon Stepseal 2K, Table XII. Piston-seal groove diameter h9 (bore H9) CHECKED: Trelleborg 'Piston Seals' catalogue (Edition January 2011), Turcon Glyd Ring, Table X. Guide-ring groove H8 / h8 and wiper groove H11: typical values quoted from memory (the guide-ring catalogue was not opened)
sources.roughness: groove surfaces Ra < 1.6 um CHECKED: Trelleborg Piston Seals catalogue (Edition January 2011), Table V 'Surface Roughness' (groove surface Ra < 1.6, Rz < 10, Rmax < 16 um; dynamic mating surfaces Ra 0.05-0.20 um for Turcon, 0.10-0.40 for Zurcon/rubber, which are the honed bore and the chromed rod, not turned here). Ra 3.2 um elsewhere: project choice
sources.stock: hollow bar, assumed sizes: 5 mm over the finished OD, bore below the finished bore
sources.tube: tube OD x wall from project 13 (HD-160 rev B: E355 182.5 x 11.25; LD-80 rev C: 90 x 5, as used by project 22). Only the head end is modelled (400 mm of tube; the rest is far beyond the reach of the jaw load). The gland-seat counterbore (H8, Ra 1.6) at the tube mouth is a DESIGN VARIANT for a stepped gland, not part of project 13's design; it stands for any toleranced turned diameter near the mouth of a thin tube.
